headline: Jeremy Bulloch signed this Boba Fett
post:
A vintage Boba Fett action figure features the autograph of actor Jeremy Bulloch in silver ink alongside the message "Stay Cool". The collectible belongs to The Power of the Force series with a red and orange cardback.

The signature was reportedly dated either May 3rd or March 5th, 2000. This personal touch makes the piece special for fans even though autographs do not dramatically boost market value compared to rarity and condition.

Would you prefer a rare un-signed toy or a common figure signed by the actor?

headline: Leaving the Sith made Maul an even better villain
post:
Star Wars is packed with unforgettable villains, but one iconic character truly transformed after leaving the dark side. According to Screen Rant, George Lucas reportedly grew to regret killing off Darth Maul in Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace. The character was later brought back in Star Wars: The Clone Wars.

Shedding his old title allowed him to grow far beyond a simple lackey. He built a criminal empire, hunted for an apprentice, and targeted Darth Sidious and Obi-Wan Kenobi. Unlike static Sith characters, this complex figure experienced grief, self-loathing, and fear of abandonment.

Fans can look forward to seeing the character return in Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord season 2, which premieres in 2027 exclusively on Disney+. 

What are your thoughts on his incredible journey? 🌌

#StarWars #DarthMaul #DisneyPlus
original_title: Star Wars' Darth Vader Replacement Didn't Have To Be A Sith To Be A Badass

headline: Kevin Feige confirms Battleworld for Avengers Secret Wars
post:
Get ready for a massive shift in the Marvel Cinematic Universe! According to Entertainment Weekly, Marvel Studios head Kevin Feige strongly hinted that "Avengers: Secret Wars" will take place on Battleworld. 

While discussing the upcoming films with the outlet, Feige described the setting as a "singular planet" where the movie happens. This massive two-parter, directed by Joe and Anthony Russo, adapts comic storylines by Jonathan Hickman. Feige even compared reading the source material to getting spoilers, noting that "Doomsday" acts like "Time Runs Out." 

With Robert Downey Jr. playing Victor von Doom, the scale is huge. That is why co-director Joe Russo explained that the narrative required two parts. Meanwhile, "Avengers: Secret Wars" is currently scheduled for release on December 17, 2027. 🌍

Are you ready to see Battleworld on the big screen?

#AvengersSecretWars #KevinFeige #MCU
original_title: Avengers: Secret Wars Setting Confirmed By Marvel, Spoiling Doomsday

headline: David Fincher Nearly Shaped Star Wars Around Droids
post:
Director David Fincher once talked with former Lucasfilm President Kathleen Kennedy about taking the studio public before Disney bought it. His rough idea for the franchise centered entirely on C-3PO and R2-D2 witnessing the Skywalker Saga as slaves. Disney's multi-billion dollar purchase ultimately stopped those plans from moving forward.

Would you have watched a movie focused on the droids' perspective? 🤖
